title: Someone To Spend Time With
lyrics:
[00:16.81]Wake up alone
[00:22.80]In the morning with no one at my side
[00:33.91]Could it be
[00:38.58]I've waited too long
[00:44.10]Waiting for the lucky one?
[00:49.88]My sweetheart, where are you?
[00:54.81]I need someone to spend time with
[01:01.26]To give and share all my love
[01:11.43]Back in bed
[01:16.44]It's 3am with no one at my side
[01:25.88]It gets real cold
[01:31.50]Because these blankets will never warm my heart
[01:43.15]My sweetheart, where are you?
[01:48.60]I need someone to spend time with
[01:54.96]To give and share all my love
[02:04.85]My sweetheart, where are you?
[02:09.79]I need someone to spend time with
[02:16.34]To give and share all my love
[02:26.28]My sweet heart, where are you?
[02:31.49]I need someone to spend time with
[02:37.79]To give and share all my love
